post.title: AMD Erased Its Entire 17% Crash in Two Days 📈
post.description:
AMD jumped 13.3% on Monday, Nov 9, and closed 4.1% above Wednesday's close, erasing Thursday's 17.3% drop in two trading days.

Monday's big movers:
📈 Coherent (COHR) +16.8%
📈 Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) +16.6%
📈 Ubiquiti (UI) +15.7%, after +15.3% on Friday
📈 Constellation Energy (CEG) +10.5%, after beating earnings (EPS $5.06 vs $3.89 expected)
📉 Nvidia (NVDA) −4.3%
📉 First Solar (FSLR) −4.7%

Thursday's chip crash, as of Monday's close (vs Wednesday's close):
📈 AMD +4.1%
📉 Micron (MU) −7.8%
📉 Nvidia (NVDA) −10.7%
📉 Sandisk (SNDK) −14.5%

S&P 500 (SPY): +2.4% · Nasdaq 100 (QQQ): +3.5% · Dow (DIA): +2.2%

Which move surprised you most? Tell me in the comments.
Subscribe for the market's biggest moves every trading day.

Moves use official closing prices. Data: Robinhood. Narrated with an AI voice. Not financial advice.

scenes.say: AMD jumped thirteen percent on Monday... and erased its entire crash from Thursday.

Coherent and Monolithic Power each jumped almost seventeen percent, and Ubiquiti almost sixteen, after fifteen on Friday. Constellation Energy rose more than ten after beating earnings. But Nvidia fell four percent, and First Solar almost five.
scenes.title: BIG MOVES · NOV 9
scenes.sub: Nov 9 vs Nov 6 close  ·  companies worth $15B+

scenes.say: Here's the round trip. Down seventeen percent on Thursday, up eleven on Friday, then thirteen more on Monday... leaving AMD four percent above Wednesday's close.
But the rest of Thursday's crash isn't erased. Micron is still almost eight percent below Wednesday's close, Nvidia almost eleven, and Sandisk more than fourteen.
